parse.title: Harness test article
parse.text:
For the harness itself, see Harness (disambiguation).
Harness test article
KindFixture
LinesA few

A harness test article is a page of made-up text that this repository's own checks feed to the Wikipedia copy, so the copy can be driven without the network. It links to another page, to a missing one, and to the outside.[1]

History

[edit]

The history is short. The word fixture appears here so find-in-page has something to find.

Early days

[edit]

Early days were earlier.

Filler paragraph 1 of the harness article, long enough that every section can reach the top of the window when its line in the contents is clicked, the way a real article does.
